meaning_first.independence_note: Fresh reviewer context, separate from the author. The blind packet was built from the original (hash 4789bf3b0f25173b53b1fa3f662cf2cf6d936ec9738974dab7169d6cce9bc3d3) and item-specific meaning findings were written to a scratch file before criteria, models, samples, starters or notes were opened. tone_balance.scope_note: Ten ordinary and two lightly funny tasks (kat-tuin, grote-tomaat), as the plan allows. Two of twelve is the rounded-up cap for a twelve-item batch. The coordinator checks the combined program count across all batches.

checks.criteria_visibility: pass: criteria are hidden until review (coordinator update of 28 October 2026), so they may name picture facts; all criteria name their concrete fact (pass lost, ill, Tuesday, cake, parcel, cat sleeps, train, book in class, Saturday meal, beach, pears, big tomato) and no prompt prints a criterion answer

decisions.boek_vergeten: Deviation from the plan (photo of the homework instead of "which page") accepted: a page number is useless without the book, and the photo gives the message a working purpose. The thought bubble is the only way to show where the book is; keep it simple at render time.
decisions.ziek_les: "Dat bent u." accepted. The picture is the only source of the reason, so the learner must know the drawn man is themselves. It is natural spoken Dutch.
decisions.tandarts_ander: The Tuesday fact must come from the prompt (premise); the model and sample need no hidden fact. Accepted.
decisions.kat_tuin: Humour carried by the picture only. "bloempot" stays off the prompt; criterion accepts garden or flowers.

diversity.within_batch: Twelve distinct purposes across instanties, gezondheid, werk, wonen-buurt, vervoer, opleiding, winkels-diensten and vrije-tijd-familie; recipients differ (library, teacher, dentist, colleagues, neighbours, friends, grandmother, mother).
diversity.set_assembly: The author's four proposed sets of three are workable; kat-tuin and grote-tomaat sit in different sets.
